_doc: What the game says when a hit meets a creature's weakness or its resistance (src/affinity.py; Brandon, bug bash 3.3.2: 'a whole set of pokemon style messages, so you know it when you are blocked or effective'). One line per action, chosen at random from the pool; the _many pools when several creatures were struck the same way. {name} is the creature with its article at a sentence start, {the} the same mid-sentence, {word} what met it (fire, silver, a cutting blow).
weak: Right where it hurts! {word_cap} finds {the}'s weakness.
{name} shrieks. It was never made to take {word}.
A telling blow! {name} has no answer to {word}.
{word_cap} bites deep. {name} is weak to it!
That is the way to hurt {the}: {word}!
resisted: {name} hardly notices. Try something other than {word}.
The blow lands, but {the} takes little of it: it resists {word}.
{name} was made to weather {word}. Not very effective.
weak_many: It's super effective! None of them can bear {word}.
resisted_many: Not very effective... they shrug off {word}.
It's not very effective: they all resist {word}.
